question: Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence. The fiction and non fictional book, that I borrowed, was interesting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bold part of the sentence needs to be replaced to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• The clause "**that I borrowed**" refers to the books, and the correct relative pronoun for objects (books) is "**which**."
 
• Other options ("whom," "what," and "whose") are not appropriate for the context, as they either refer to people or change the meaning.
 
• Thus, the correct replacement is "**which I borrowed**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The fiction and non-fictional book, **which I borrowed**, was interesting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "whom I borrowed"** – The pronoun "whom" is used for people, not objects, so this option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 2: "what I borrowed"** – This option introduces ambiguity and changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "whose I borrowed"** – The word "whose" indicates possession and does not fit the context of the sentence.
